title: Blind Crown — Nightfall
description: Private-plan medieval archery for 2–10 contestant slots. Nightfall adds textured diorama arenas, armored knights, torchlight, matching portraits, responsive controls and timed volley effects while preserving Classic rules. One local human with bots; first/third-person default to Canvas 2.5D. Hosted phone multiplayer is not integrated.

source.provenance: Nightfall v1.5 presentation upgrade from the exact supplied Refined v1.4 game, preserved under source/original/. New original Canvas/SVG art and synthesized audio; no external art/font/music packs added. Current standalone SHA-256: 06a0238b9827cd6f4395ec33cd0b2c8c7ce758bc15135a946ed7c737e53ef0e4. Experimental pinned Three.js remains opt-in and unverified. See assets/README.md.
